heading: Sockets
body: SocketRoute marks a controller that keeps a WebSocket open at its path. Put the class in server/controllers/ in any Yon language (.js, .ts, .py, .go, .java, .groovy, .kt, .cs, .fs, .php, .rb, .rs, .dart or .lua). Tachyon makes one object for each connection, as Jakarta's @ServerEndpoint does. OnOpen runs when a browser connects, OnMessage runs for each message, OnClose runs when the socket closes, and OnError runs when OnOpen or OnMessage fails; the socket stays open, as in Jakarta. The session sends messages back, closes the socket, and lists the open sessions of the same path with openSessions() (each language uses its own style, such as open_sessions() in Python). Each message is JSON text of at most 64 KiB, and Tachyon checks it against the model type of the OnMessage parameter. In Lua, a message that is not JSON or is nested more than 64 levels deep goes to OnError, and the socket stays open. When the browser closes the socket, Tachyon answers with the same close code, so the browser sees a clean close. SocketRequest on an HTTPClient method receives the messages in the browser, and the client's send(message) sends one. In Go, the client is an interface method, the service receives the messages with `// @OnEvent`, and `Send(message any) error` sends one. In Rust, the client is a trait method, the service receives the messages with `#[OnEvent]`, and `send(message).await` sends one. Public, SignedIn or Allow(Role) on the SocketRoute class says who may connect. Tachyon checks it before it opens the socket, and answers 401 or 403 instead. The socket path has no {variables}. Tachyon guards every socket: a message that is not JSON or does not fit the model closes it with code 1007, a binary message with 1003, and a message larger than 64 KiB with 1009. Five minutes without a message closes it with 1001, and a socket lasts at most one hour. At most 32 sockets are open at once in the whole server, and the next one gets 503. A browser page from another origin gets 403. A plain HTTP request to the path gets 426 Upgrade Required. /api.json marks the path with "socket": true and names the message model.
